title: Match of the Day
synopsis_short: Highlights from five Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Nottingham Forest.
synopsis_medium: Highlights from five Premier League matches, including Liverpool’s first home game of the season against Nottingham Forest and a clash between two newly promoted teams as Coventry host Hull.
synopsis_long: Highlights from five Premier League matches, including Liverpool’s first home game of the season against Nottingham Forest. Two of the newly promoted teams meet as Coventry host Hull. Spurs take on Newcastle, and Bournemouth face Everton. Plus highlights of Friday night’s game between Crystal Palace and Manchester City.
synopsis_editorial: With Liverpool v Forest and Coventry’s first home game against fellow new boys Hull
